query: UPDATE outbox e SET attempts=greatest(e.attempts,f.attempts),available_at=f.available_at,dead_letter_at=coalesce(e.dead_letter_at,f.dead_letter_at),error_code='projection_failed' FROM outbox_subscriber_failures f WHERE e.id=$1 AND e.tenant=$2 AND f.tenant=e.tenant AND f.event_id=e.id AND f.subscriber=$3
